_comment: VIDEO generation (TikTok, adverts). This is a MOTION brief, not
a face description: the face comes from the still render, which
is why still.json is generated first. Re-describing the face in
text is exactly how identity drifts between clips.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

reference_image.source: appearance/still.json -> the approved headshot or classroom render for this tutor
reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Do not go the other way and pull a still out of a clip - video frames are soft, motion-blurred and compressed.

identity_lock: royal-blue shirt with nceka-print collar, placket and cuffs
_identity_lock_note: COPIED from still.json continuity_anchors - never edited here. The face lives in the reference image and its description lives in still.json; duplicating either is how this file went stale while still.json was corrected repeatedly.

performance.energy: taxi-rank storyteller - fast, funny, completely at ease
performance.body: never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point
performance.expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy

camera.framing: 9:16 vertical for TikTok - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, same accessories and same hairstyle across a campaign; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this tutor's own scripts (greetings/, signoffs/, samples.json)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a tutor

shots.purpose: TikTok / advert hook, talking to camera
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. THE PERSON FROM THE REFERENCE IMAGE - do not restyle the face, hair, clothing or age. Energy: taxi-rank storyteller - fast, funny, completely at ease Delivery: easy storytelling pace, streetwise warmth never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point Background: , softly out of focus. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural handheld micro-movement, real-photography look, 8 seconds.

shots.purpose: background b-roll, not looking at camera
shots.prompt: THE PERSON FROM THE REFERENCE IMAGE teaching in . never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point Not looking at camera. Documentary feel, natural light, static camera or slow push-in, real-photography look, 8 seconds.

negative_prompt: face drifting from the reference image, changing age, changing skin tone, changing hairline, morphing wardrobe, warping hands, extra fingers, jittering eyes, lip-sync mismatch, whip pans, orbiting camera, speed ramps, slow motion, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_no_face_description: This file must NEVER describe the face, hair, wardrobe or age. That belongs to still.json and to the reference render. Re-describing it here is how identity drifts between clips, and how this file fell behind every correction made to still.json.
